title: Are Benchmarks Reliable? Toward Structural Diagnosis via Item-Level Capability Boundaries
abstract: arXiv:2609.33196v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Evaluating large language models (LLMs) relies heavily on benchmark scores, yet aggregate metrics can obscure whether individual items serve their intended measurement purpose. BSDProbe provides an item-level framework for benchmark structural diagnosis that jointly characterizes correctness transitions and their supporting response evidence. Repeated responses along an empirically ordered model axis yield complementary correctness and normalized entropy trajectories, from which four-dimensional profiles of boundary position, boundary width, boundary-signal validity, and order consistency are constructed for benchmark-level aggregation. Experiments on six benchmarks identify varying proportions of potentially anomalous items. With Qwen3 as both the selection and reference axis, BSDProbe achieves a 17.9\% mean relative improvement in normalized discrimination ratio over the best baseline per benchmark and matches or exceeds all baseli

translated_title: 基准测试可靠吗？基于条目级能力边界的结构化诊断方法研究
translated_abstract: 对大型语言模型（LLM）的评估高度依赖基准测试分数，然而总体聚合指标可能掩盖单个题目是否真正实现了其预期的测量目的。BSDProbe提供了一个条目级的基准测试结构化诊断框架，联合表征正确性转变及其背后的支持性响应证据。通过沿经验排序的模型轴进行重复响应，可获得互补的正确性轨迹和归一化熵轨迹，并从中构建出边界位置、边界宽度、边界信号有效性和顺序一致性这四个维度的画像，进而用于基准测试层面的聚合分析。在六个基准测试上的实验识别出了不同比例的潜在异常题目。当以Qwen3同时作为选择轴和参考轴时，BSDProbe在归一化判别比上相比每个基准测试的最佳基线实现了平均17.9%的相对提升，并达到或超过所有基线方法。
tldr: 提出BSDProbe条目级框架，通过能力边界的四维画像对基准测试进行结构化诊断并识别异常题目，在六个基准上相比最佳基线平均提升17.9%的归一化判别比。
en_tdlr: BSDProbe is an item-level structural diagnosis framework for benchmarks that profiles capability boundaries to identify potentially anomalous items, achieving a 17.9% mean relative improvement in normalized discrimination ratio over the best baselines across six benchmarks.
